spans.s: लूत्वा, ind. having cut or divided, &c.

लूता लूता, f. a spider; an ant; a kind of
cutaneous disease (said to be produced by moisture
from a spider).
—लूता-तन्तु, उस्, m. a spider's web,
cobweb.
—लूता-मर्कटक, अस्, m. an ape; Arabian
jasmine; = पुत्री.
—लूतारि (˚ता-अरि), इस्, m. ‘spider-
enemy, ‘a kind of shrub (= दुग्ध-फेनी).
